newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi to award part of $350 mln steel plant.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi to award part of $350 mln steel plant.

text.p: Abu Dhabi is close to awarding an international firm the first part of a $350 million deal to build a steel bar plant, an industry official said on Tuesday.
Issa Atiq, director general of the oil-rich emirate's General Industry Corp (GIC), said the Abu Dhabi government would soon award a contract to supply the machinery for the project.
"The whole deal for the civil work and the machinery will cost $350 million," he told Reuters. "Soon we are going to award the machinery contract," he said.

Atiq said the factory would produce 500,000 tonnes of steel bars a year and would be built in Abu Dhabi. He did not provide details on the companies which are vying for the contract but said the competition was between Italian and German firms.
He said it would be Abu Dhabi's first major steel factory.
GIC promotes non-oil industry in the emirate.
Atiq said international companies were also competing to undertake a feasibility study for an aluminium smelter in Abu Dhabi. He would not name the companies or provide details.

Abu Dhabi, the richest of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates, is blessed with vast oil wealth. The emirate is trying to diversify its economy and find more channels for foreign and private investment.
